title: ZOMBRA update, building a zombie survival game with Claude Code and Codex
author: Straight-Tea-8564
selftext:
I shared an early version of ZOMBRA here recently. I have since updated the character art and expanded the world beyond the abandoned city, with a survivor base, ruins and a pickup escort mission. Here is the new trailer.



The game uses JavaScript and Phaser, with help from Claude Code and Codex. Much of the pixel art is drawn procedurally in code. For the trailer, the game's studio runs scripted shots inside the engine, without the HUD.



I gave specific feedback to keep characters moving while firing, alternate fights between the city and ruins, time the cuts to the music and lower the music slightly during narration. Watching the actual footage and correcting individual moments made a big difference.



It is still in development for solo and online co-op play. You can watch the trailer and join the launch waitlist at https://zombra.online/.
